_comment: PSI-25 BASS-II T16 (train partition), clip PSI-25_Raw Data_BASS_GMT100_SAMPLE_139_TEST_T16.mp4 (sha256 ca844bcc8a61a925c949fdb1db0b209a2aca5b9d3118a8228570150fc87022e9). SIDE VIEW, EDGE-ON: the camera sees the SIBAL sheet edge-on (Summary Report NASA/TM-20210011385 p.102 s7.1.3), so f = image x along the sample, s = image y (height above/below the sheet). PIXEL-ONLY: no in-frame metric reference could be located to +/-2 px (no legible scale, sample ends not crisp); see docs/raul/02-bass-video-findings.md on branch feature/bass-calibration. propagation_sign=-1: flow is right->left in the side view (same report p.103, Fig. 7.2 text), so the downstream luminous tip is the smallest image x. igniter glow x~480-580 px (sample frame positioned differently from T5/T6).

_frames_notes.measured_with: background-subtracted luminous-extent scan on ignis vision frames cache (diagnostic)
_frames_notes.time_origin_note: exact container PTS of the start frame (frame*1001/30000; verified against the contour locators)

_visibility: flame visible in the side view only for ~5-7 s after onset; afterwards it is too dim (low flow), so most frames yield out_of_field/no contour
notes: pixel_only side view (f=x, s=y in px); overlay (y<90) excluded; bottom 10 px excluded; frames outside [_frames.start,_frames.stop] are setup lighting or still-camera playback and must not be segmented; T16: right edge x>=688 occluded (static vertical chroma artifact produced ~30 false single-valued contours per 5 s for 140 s in a first pass)

frames.rule: start = first frame (3-frame resolution) with >=3 luminous columns after the lit setup period (igniter-glow onset, provisional, not an adjudicated ignition time); stop = last frame before the still-camera playback screen appears in the main video
